stem: An Aboriginal child with community-acquired pneumonia has lobar consolidation. Which bacterial pathogen is the most common cause to target initially?
explanation: Streptococcus pneumoniae is the most common bacterial cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children and is a key target of initial empirical therapy.
